decision: Do not port another half-plane identity convenience wrapper. Four current sources already call Mathlib identity principle. Preserve differing regularizations and open analytic/arithmetic inputs.
narrowed_next_target: Reverse Mellin inversion in ContinuationInversion.lean (mellin_mellinInv_eq), only as a separately allocated Analysis/IntegralTransforms port with exact hypotheses and an actual consumer proving representation/convergence inputs; signalMellin_eq_on_line is a source-level consumer but does not itself discharge representation.
